rules: 100 积分抵扣 CAD 1，每次按整数 CAD 使用，剩余积分保留。
100 points = CAD 1. Redeem in whole CAD amounts; unused points stay in your account.
earn_rule: 注册账号即可获得166积分；每次通过网站预约并到店游玩可获得166 积分。
Receive 166 points when you register an account, and 166 points each time you book through the website and attend a beading session.
time_rule: 储值、赠送与实际扣时由店主核实后记录。预约不会自动扣除钱包时长。
The host records verified top-ups, gifts and time used. Making a booking does not deduct wallet time.
redeem_rule: 积分在到店结算时由店主确认抵扣，也可在拼豆小店购物使用。
The host confirms redemption when you settle your visit. Points can also be used for purchases in the Little shop.
empty: 还没有明细，店主记账后会显示在这里。
No entries yet. Records will appear after the host saves them.
page: 第 {v0} 页 · 共 {v1} 条
attendance_help: 填写实际游玩时间，完成到店记录后赠送 166 积分；不会自动扣钱包时长。
Record the actual time. Completing attendance awards 166 points; wallet time is not deducted automatically.
members_intro: 记录储值时长、到店消费与积分，每一笔都有明细。
Record prepaid time, visits and points with an entry for every change.
search: 搜索姓名、邮箱、账号或备注
Search name, email, account ID or host note
register_first: 请让顾客先用邮箱登录网站一次。老用户已有的时长可在账户中录入，不会按联系邮箱自动认领。
Ask the guest to sign in to the website with email first. You can then record their existing time balance on that account.
reverse_help: 将以一笔相反的变动撤销原记账，保留两笔明细。
An opposite entry reverses this change. Both entries remain in the history.
debit_help: 填写正数，保存时会从余额中扣除。多人共用时，请填写合计消费分钟。
Enter a positive number to deduct. For shared time, enter the total minutes used by all guests.
adjust_help: 更正填写变化量：正数增加，负数扣除。
Enter the change: positive adds, negative deducts.
uncertain: 还未确认这笔是否保存成功。请重试同一笔，不要重复新建；系统会核对记录，避免重复扣款或入账。
This entry has not been confirmed. Retry the same entry instead of creating another; the system checks it to prevent duplicates.
delete_help: 删除后将从顾客和当前列表中隐藏，可在已删除列表恢复。时长和积分明细保留；已确认的预约请先取消。
Hide this booking from the guest and current list. Restore it from Deleted bookings. Time and points entries stay; cancel confirmed bookings first.
wallet_insufficient_balance: 余额不足，未保存任何变动。请核对时长和积分。
Insufficient balance. No changes were saved. Check the time and points.
wallet_member_missing: 顾客账户还未建立，请让顾客先登录一次。
This guest account is not available yet. Ask the guest to sign in first.
wallet_amount_too_large: 金额或时长超出可记录范围，请核对。
The amount exceeds the recording limit. Please check it.
wallet_request_changed: 重试内容发生变化，请先刷新核对原明细。
The retry details changed. Refresh and check the original entry first.
wallet_opening_exists: 该账户已有明细；补充旧记录请使用充值、赠送或更正。
This account already has entries. Use a top-up, gift or adjustment for further records.
wallet_reservation_mismatch: 预约不存在、已删除或不属于该顾客，请核对编号。
The booking is missing, deleted or belongs to another guest. Check the reference.
wallet_reservation_incomplete: 请先完成该预约的到店记录，再关联消费扣时或积分抵扣。
Complete this booking’s attendance record before linking a debit or redemption.
wallet_entry_missing: 没有找到这笔明细，请刷新。
This entry was not found. Refresh the records.
wallet_already_reversed: 这笔已撤销，不能再次撤销。
This entry has already been reversed.
wallet_visit_not_arrived: 预约日期尚未到来，不能提前完成并赠分。
This visit is in the future. It cannot be completed or rewarded yet.
wallet_actual_details_required: 请同时填写实际游玩分钟和人数。
Enter both the actual minutes and number of guests.
wallet_completed_record_locked: 这次到店已赠分。可更正实际时长；误记到店请先在顾客账户撤销赠分，再改状态。
Points were awarded for this visit. You can correct its duration. To undo attendance, reverse the reward in the guest account before changing the status.
reservation_cancel_before_delete: 请先取消已确认的预约，再删除。
Cancel this confirmed booking before deleting it.
promotion_rule: 积分和优惠活动不可同时使用。
Points cannot be combined with promotional offers.
no_promotion: 确认本单未使用其他优惠活动
I confirm this bill does not use another promotional offer
wallet_promotion_confirmation_required: 积分和优惠活动不可同时使用，请确认本单未使用其他优惠。
Points cannot be combined with promotional offers. Confirm that this bill has no other offer.
wallet_redemption_use_required: 请选择到店游玩或小店购物。
Choose a studio visit or Little shop purchase.
